definitions.bonds: round 0 of the word learner (vocab.py / words.py run_words, copied): a gene is labelled by its family if the family is present in >= 2 counting units, else background; occurrences = labelled gene pairs on one contig at distance d in {1,2,3} (<= 2 intervening genes) with different labels; key = unordered label pair; n = units with an occurrence of the key; E = expected_groups (w = 3); Lambda = n ln(n/E) - n + E; significant if n >= 2 and Lambda >= tau (syn: Lambda_eff = Lambda N_eff / n >= tau and N_eff >= 2). Every occurrence of a significant key is a bond.
definitions.boundary_score: s_k (boundary between genes k and k+1) = largest Lambda (syn: Lambda_eff) of any bond spanning k; 0 if none
definitions.L1: loci = maximal runs of boundaries with s_k > 0 (= transfer_spacedust CC2 on the same statistic)
definitions.L2(theta): L1 runs cut at every boundary with kappa < theta (kappa NaN = no cut); one-gene pieces dropped; theta ladder {0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2}
definitions.L3(theta): L2(theta) loci UNION the stage-1 word loci under reading V-mob (DPANN: stored vocab/loci/main_tau10_V-mob.parquet, the .624 output; Spacedust: V-mob of the group run at tau* made here, and of P2's syn run for the syn row); words outside any L2 locus are kept by construction

L4(theta).a: s'_k = s_k, set to 0 where kappa < theta (NaN = no cut); theta = the theta selected for L2
L4(theta).b: for each maximal run of boundaries with s'_k > 0, the min-rooted Cartesian tree with ties collapsed (all boundaries equal to a node's weakest value split it at once, so every node has persistence > 0); built by processing boundaries in decreasing s' with union-find; node = gene interval I; m = weakest internal boundary; e = stronger delimiting boundary = parent's m (0 for a run root); persistence = m - e
L4(theta).c: kept if >= 2 genes, persistence >= delta, n >= 2 and Lambda(n, E) >= tau_node. |I| = genes of I whose family has >= 2 genes in the collection (singleton families excluded); F_I = distinct families of those genes; window W = c |I| genes with c = 2; required families q = max(2, ceil(phi |F_I|)) with phi = 0.5 (interpretation, fixed now: the brief's ceil(phi |I|) taken over distinct families so a node with repeated families can still be met, and at least 2 families so that joint recurrence is a co-location and not one family's presence; identical to the brief when no family repeats inside I and |I| >= 3). n = number of counting groups other than the node's own group with at least one genome holding >= q distinct families of F_I within a window of <= W consecutive genes on one contig.
L4(theta).E_L4: literal: mean over the 3 within-genome token shuffles (seeds 1000-1002, the learner's null corpora) of the same count (groups other than the node's own holding the window in the shuffled corpus). E = 0 with n >= 2 gives Lambda = +inf (passes every tau_node).
L4(theta).E_L4a: variant: the expectation of that count under random order within genomes in closed form (Poisson clumping): per genome mu_g = m_g C(W-1, q-1) q! e_q(c_f(g)/m_g) over the families of F_I present in g (e_q = elementary symmetric polynomial), P_group = 1 - exp(-sum_g mu_g), E = sum over other groups. For q = 2 families and W = 4 it equals the bond statistic's per-genome term 2 w c_X c_Y / m_g (w = 3). Reason for the variant: with 3 shuffles the literal E has resolution 1/3 group and is 0 for most multi-gene nodes, so Lambda is infinite; the closed form has no resolution floor.
L4(theta).delta_tau_node: gold-free, separately for L4 and L4a: ladders delta {0,1,2,5,10,20,50,100} x tau_node {0,2,4,6,8,10,12,15,20,30}; null = the whole procedure (bonds at the same bond tau, tree, test) on each of the 3 shuffled corpora, without a cohesion cut (kappa exists only for the real order; omitting the cut gives more null nodes, a conservative choice), null E from the other two shuffled corpora (L4) or the closed form (L4a); FDR = mean null kept nodes / observed kept nodes; choose among pairs with FDR <= 0.01 the pair with the most observed kept nodes (ties: larger delta, then larger tau_node)

definitions.L4+: interpretation of 'locus identity ignored entirely (no words)': the same persistence tree with test (c) dropped: every node with >= 2 genes and persistence >= delta (L4's delta), no recurrence test, no words
definitions.L4b: not predeclared; if a cleaner formulation is built it is added by amendment before its numbers and labelled

amendment_2_L4b.status_when_written: Read before writing: the gold-free build summary of DPANN groups (bond counts, locus counts and spans, node counts, calibration). NOT read: any odd or even score of any output (the odd scoring step was running; its log lines were not opened).
amendment_2_L4b.observation: The node null is nearly empty (62 / 30 / 36 null nodes against 818k observed at theta 0.02), because the bond tau already empties the shuffled landscape: every theta selects delta = 0, tau_node = 0, so L4 = L4a and the recurrence test reduces to n >= 2 (it removes 4-6% of nodes). The closed-form E sums to 1.19x the shuffled count over all nodes (conservative). L4 can never be longer than an L2 locus, because the cohesion cut is applied before the tree.

L4b.a: boundary strength over the L1 runs without a hard cut: w_k = s_k where kappa_k >= theta or NaN; w_k = 1e-6 + max(kappa_k, 0) where kappa_k < theta (a positive value below every bond Lambda, since Lambda >= tau >= 4 > theta): low-cohesion junctions become the first splits instead of cuts
L4b.b: the same tie-collapsed tree, over L1 runs
L4b.c: node kept if >= 2 genes, n >= 2 and Lambda(n, E_closed_form) >= tau, the bond tau (10 on DPANN groups; tau* on Spacedust): one significance threshold for the parts (bonds) and the whole (node); q, W, n exactly as L4; no delta and no node-level calibration
L4b.d: output = kept nodes (nested); theta = L2's selected theta
L4b.why: cohesion orders the splits and recurrence decides which levels survive, so a long locus with a low-cohesion junction can still be reported whole if it recurs as a whole; the whole is tested at the bonds' own threshold instead of a threshold calibrated on an empty null
L4b.expectation: DPANN: more long parents than L4; ribosomal resolved within -60 / +40 of L4 (parents can take the best-overlap slot from a better-fitting child); summed within .03 of L4. Spacedust: excess above L4 by +.01 to +.05, union coverage of regions above L4
